snippet.title: Who Summoned It? - Official Game Trailer 2
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Who Summoned It? is here! We are a small husband and wife team making our first game together. 

This is a point and click deduction mystery. Explore the town of Knotgud, interrogate townsfolk, and use magical items. Use your discoveries to piece events together in your scroll of truth and find out, Who Summoned It?
If you like Detective Grimoire and The Case of the Golden Idol we think you'll like this! 

Wishlist it on Steam! Demo out now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3682850/Who_Summoned_It/
